Aaron — thanks, and really appreciate the quick review. Looping in Ben (SE), Vivek (Onboarding lead), and Hannah (MAP owner) to close the remaining questions.

High level proposal (we can put this into the MAP spreadsheet as milestones):

1) Day 0–1: Org & API keys
   - Redwood creates a provisional org on our control plane; customer provides org name and admin email.
   - We will issue scoped API keys and a staging key for test traffic.
2) Day 2–3: IP allowlist
   - Ben will provide the exact egress IPs and recommend prefix ranges to add to your firewall.
3) Day 3–5: VPC peering prep and diagram
   - Provide CIDR suggestions and peering diagram. Customer cloud team to accept peering request; expected acceptance depends on internal approval.
4) Day 6: Smoke test & acceptance window
   - End-to-end test with sample traffic; acceptance criteria: successful token exchange and <120ms median latency on short runs.

Action owners:
- Marissa: MAP coordination + commercial dates
- Ben: IP ranges, peering requirements, network attachments
- Vivek: orchestration of peering and staging environment
- Hannah: internal MAP checkpoints and final close cadence

I've attached a first-pass MAP workbook (map-v1.xlsx) and a stubbed peering diagram. Ben, can you drop the allowlist CSV this afternoon? Aaron/Sally — target signoff for the MAP by 2026-10-24 to keep the go-live window in early November.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: MAP draft — final tech asks for POC onramp

Aaron, team — attaching the allowlist CSV and a short tech note. See quick answers inline: 

- Static egress IP: Redwood offers a small pool of stable egress IPs from our Dedicated edge for customers on the MAP; for hosted MAPs we can provide a recommended set (listed in network-allowlist.csv).
- CIDR recommendation for peering: suggest reserving /24 from your environment for the peering tunnel (examples in diagram).
- Service account: we recommend customer-provisioned IAM service account with the following scopes: compute.networkAdmin (for peering acceptance), storage.objectViewer (logs), and a restricted Redwood role for key provisioning.

Tech checklist (to include in MAP):
- Allowlist entries: 34.201.18.12/32, 3.18.55.0/24, 54.152.120.8/32 (see CSV)
- Peering handshake: customer opens peering, Redwood accepts, route propagation validated within 2 hours
- Firewall: allow TCP 443 outbound to Redwood endpoints and UDP 1194 if you plan to use tunnel-based verification

Attachment: network-allowlist.csv (text, 1KB)

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Ben — thanks for the specifics, that helps a lot. Two follow-ups from our cloud/security team: 

1) They prefer customer-provisioned service accounts. We'll create the IAM role and send the service account email by EOD Tuesday (2026-10-26).
2) Procurement note: Sally asked whether Redwood can commit to the activation window in the SOW; she requested a 7-day slack for calendar reasons. Any flexibility on the MAP target signoff date?

Sally (copied) — do you want us to proceed with a provisional PO and then finalize after the MAP signoff?

On timing, if we get the service account on 10/26 and allowlist done the next day, we should be able to accept the peering on 10/29. That moves us slightly later than your 10/24 signoff — is a 10/29 MAP signoff acceptable?

Best,
Aaron

Thanks Aaron — appreciate the transparency on timelines. Hannah and Vivek and I talked through the internal schedule; we're OK pushing the MAP signoff to 2026-10-29 provided we keep the following firm commitments:

- 2026-10-26: BeacondX provides service account email + confirmation of org admin contact
- 2026-10-27: BeacondX updates firewall with allowlist (network-allowlist.csv applied)
- 2026-10-28: Redwood initiates peering request; BeacondX accepts by EOD 10/29
- 2026-10-29: MAP signoff (commercial & technical acceptance) — go/no-go window; target to begin limited traffic the following week

Marissa (commercial) will update the MAP workbook and share a final version (map-v1.xlsx v1.1) with milestone dates and owner columns. Sally — provisional PO is fine; we'll mark it as pending MAP signoff in the SOW language.

Next steps: I'll upload updated MAP and a short runbook to our Drive link, and schedule a 30-minute sync for 2026-10-27 to validate allowlist and peering readiness.

Cheers,
